title: Update cap table
summary: Keep the cap table current after new SAFEs, grants, or transfers — reconciled and board-approved.

parts.title: Export current cap table
parts.guidance: Export the cap table and transaction history at a stated date before making updates. Include the security classes and fully diluted assumptions needed for a meaningful comparison, separating pending drafts from completed transactions. Keep this baseline so the equity administrator can identify the individual holdings and totals changed by the reconciliation.

parts.title: Reconcile recent transactions
parts.guidance: Match recent grants, exercises, financings, transfers and cancellations to executed records and existing entries. Identify missing data, inconsistent terms and actions lacking legal authority separately. Show the proposed corrections with dates, holders, securities and quantities. The authorized equity administrator can correct supported records, while missing authority or conflicting terms go to counsel before ownership changes are recorded.

parts.title: Draft the board consent for the changes
parts.guidance: Use the reconciled transactions to identify with counsel which actions need a corporate decision. Draft the consent for those specific recipients, quantities and terms, checking plan or charter capacity and the required decision-makers. Explain any earlier defect explicitly so the proposed action addresses it through the appropriate process.

parts.title: Board signs the consent
parts.guidance: The authorized directors or other required decision-makers review and sign the final consent with its transaction schedule. Match revisions to both the resolution and proposed equity entries, and establish when the approval becomes effective. Give the equity administrator the specific authorized changes for entry and reconciliation.

metadata.supportReason: Carta integration planned. Requires reviewing and reconciling existing cap table data.
